quickRide.onlineBody: Ride requests near you will show up here.
quickRide.offlineBody: Go online to start receiving ride requests.
quickRide.reconnectingBody: Your spot is held for a few minutes. Hang tight.
quickRide.emptyBody: Tap Go online and nearby ride requests will start arriving.
quickRide.waitingBody: You're in the queue. New requests appear the moment a rider books nearby.
quickRide.bidLocked: One bid at a time — withdraw your live bid to bid here.
quickRide.withdrawBody: The rider won't see your offer any more. You can bid again while the ride is open.
quickRide.cannotLower: You've already bid {{amount}}, which is the lowest fare allowed on this ride. A bid can only be lowered, never raised.
quickRide.bidNote: Bids run for 60 seconds. You can lower a bid, but never raise it.
quickRide.bidFailed: Couldn't place your bid. Please try again.
quickRide.onRideToDrop: Trip in progress — head to the drop.

quickRide.blockVehicleBody: Add the vehicle you'll be driving so we know which rides to send you.
quickRide.blockLocationBody: We need your location to match you with nearby riders. Allow location access and try again.
quickRide.blockConnectionBody: Check your connection and try going online again.
quickRide.blockUnknownBody: Something went wrong. Please try again.

outstation.point3: Fares agreed up front, no bidding

ride.completeBody: Only do this once the rider has reached the drop-off.
ride.completeFailed: Couldn't complete the ride. Please try again.
ride.cancelBody: Tell the rider why. Cancelling too often affects the rides you're offered.

kyc.title: Aadhaar KYC
kyc.statusVerifiedBody: Your Aadhaar has been verified. Nothing more to do here.
kyc.statusPendingBody: Verify your Aadhaar through DigiLocker to start accepting rides.
kyc.confirmingBody: Checking your verification with our servers. This takes a few seconds.
kyc.step1: Tap Verify with Aadhaar to open DigiLocker.
kyc.step2: Give consent, then enter your Aadhaar number and the OTP sent to your linked mobile.
kyc.step3: Come back to the app — we confirm the result automatically.
kyc.consentNote: You are handed over to DigiLocker, the Government of India service. We never see your Aadhaar number or OTP.
kyc.verifiedNote: Your Aadhaar details are stored securely and are never shown in the app.
kyc.stillProcessing: Verification is still processing. This can take a moment — try again shortly, and contact support if it keeps failing.
kyc.statusFailedBody: We couldn't verify your Aadhaar. You can start the verification again.
kyc.startFailed: Verification is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
kyc.webviewFailed: Couldn't load the verification page. Please try again.
kyc.statusFailed: Couldn't check your verification status. Pull down to refresh.
kyc.processingBody: Hang on while we confirm your Aadhaar verification. This takes a few seconds.
kyc.continueFailed: Couldn't load your verified details. Please try again.
